wiki.title: Phil Rubin
wiki.extract: Phillip Anthony Rubin (born August 17, 1983) is an American attorney and politician serving in the North Carolina House of Representatives. In 2025, Governor Josh Stein appointed him, a member of the Democratic Party, to fill the seat vacated by the resignation of Rep. Joe John. Upon appointment, Governor Stein praised Rubin for "stepping up to serve the people...[and] improve the lives of all North Carolinians."
